title: Facebook post comments
description: One row per publicly served Facebook comment or reply.

source_post_url.description: Holds the canonical Facebook URL of the post from which the comment was collected.

source_post_id.description: Identifies the numeric Facebook post ID parsed from the URL or page data, or null when unresolvable.

input_url.description: Preserves the original post URL as supplied in the Actor input before normalization, or null if unavailable.

post_text.description: Provides the text content of the source Facebook post for context, or null when it could not be extracted.

source_comment_id.description: Carries the comment identifier as exposed in the Facebook permalink or page payload before internal normalization.

raw_id.description: Contains the unprocessed opaque comment identifier exactly as extracted from Facebook page data.

decoded_id.description: Gives the decoded numeric comment identifier derived from the raw encoded value for joining and deduplication.

parent_comment_id.description: References the decoded identifier of the parent comment for a reply, or null for a top-level comment.

depth.description: Indicates comment nesting level as an integer where 0 means top-level and 1 or higher means a reply.

author_id.description: Identifies the numeric Facebook user or page ID of the comment author, or null when anonymous or hidden.

author_name.description: Shows the display name of the comment author exactly as rendered on Facebook.

author_url.description: Links to the public Facebook profile or page of the comment author, or null when unavailable.

author_picture.description: Points to the HTTPS URL of the author profile picture thumbnail, or null when not exposed.

raw_text.description: Holds the full plain-text body of the comment as displayed, or null for sticker, attachment-only, or empty comments.

extracted_urls.description: Lists HTTPS URLs detected inside the comment text as an array of strings, or null when none were found.

created_time.description: Records comment creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, or null when Facebook did not expose it.

created_at.description: Expresses comment creation time as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp string derived from the Unix value, or null when unknown.

reactions.description: Counts the total number of reactions on the comment as an integer.

likes.description: Counts reactions of type Like, retained separately for backward compatibility with like-only consumers.

reactions_breakdown.description: Maps each Facebook reaction type to its integer count for the comment, or null when breakdown data is unavailable.

reply_count.description: Counts direct replies under this comment as an integer.

comments_count.description: Reports the total comment count of the source post at scrape time for summary context, repeated on comment rows.

comment_url.description: Points to the direct Facebook permalink URL of this specific comment or reply.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Comment text, author, reactions, timestamp, thread depth, and permalink.
